name: Powerwell Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Powerwell完成以RM16.66百万收购Tenaga Kenari Sdn Bhd与Tenaga Kenari Marketing Sdn Bhd各49%股权，并启动两家休眠全资子公司的成员自愿清盘，作为集团架构精简的一部分。公司亦推进凭单派发计划。
overview_en: In 2026, Powerwell completed the acquisition of 49% equity interest each in Tenaga Kenari Sdn Bhd and Tenaga Kenari Marketing Sdn Bhd for RM16.66 million, and commenced members' voluntary winding-up of two dormant wholly-owned subsidiaries as part of a group rationalisation exercise. The company also progressed a bonus issue of warrants.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 完成收购两家公司各49%股权，并对两家休眠子公司启动自愿清盘以精简架构。
segments.note_en: Completed acquisition of 49% equity interest in two companies and commenced voluntary winding-up of two dormant subsidiaries to streamline structure.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司DB Power Sdn Bhd及Powerwell Marketing Sdn Bhd已停止营运并处于休眠状态，于2026年11月18日启动成员自愿清盘。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiaries DB Power Sdn Bhd and Powerwell Marketing Sdn Bhd, which have ceased operations and are dormant, commenced members' voluntary winding-up on 18 November 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以RM16.66百万现金完成收购Tenaga Kenari Sdn Bhd及Tenaga Kenari Marketing Sdn Bhd各49%股权，余额已于2026年4月1日付清。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of 49% equity interest each in Tenaga Kenari Sdn Bhd and Tenaga Kenari Marketing Sdn Bhd for a total cash consideration of RM16.66 million, with balance purchase consideration fully paid on 1 April 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 于2026年3月27日就上述收购签订补充协议。
actions.text_en: Entered into supplemental agreements on 27 March 2026 in relation to the acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就上述收购提供额外资料，包括分期支付总代价的安排条款。
actions.text_en: Provided additional information on the acquisition, including terms of deferred payment of the total consideration.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过收购Tenaga Kenari Sdn Bhd及Tenaga Kenari Marketing Sdn Bhd各49%股权，集团将业务延伸至两家公司所属领域。
model_changes.text_en: Through the acquisition of 49% equity interest each in Tenaga Kenari Sdn Bhd and Tenaga Kenari Marketing Sdn Bhd, the group extends into the business areas of these two companies.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 对两家已停止营运的休眠全资子公司启动成员自愿清盘，作为集团架构精简措施。
model_changes.text_en: Commenced members' voluntary winding-up of two dormant wholly-owned subsidiaries that have ceased operations, as part of a group rationalisation exercise.
